mentions.name: Crucible
mentions.description: This platform uses agents to orchestrate the entire lifecycle of building custom AI: it hooks into how a team currently uses AI, prepares and labels their data, detects the best recipes for the task, fine-tunes models, and deploys them. It skips a chat-first UX and instead auto-detects the AI tasks a user has already built, aiming to let non-experts "Vibe ML" their way to custom AI.
mentions.problem: Most people lack the expertise, money, and time to build custom AI themselves.
mentions.audience: Any AI engineer or PM who wants to build custom AI without ML expertise.
mentions.source_excerpt: So we built these agents that orchestrate the entire life-cycle of custom AI. We start by hooking into how you use AI, prepare/label your data, detect the best recipes for your task, fine-tune, and deploy it for you.
